definitions.rotation: Absolute wrapped per-tick executed facing deltas, through the step ending1.20s. Requested heading variation uses the exact defaultFacing fallback from kinematics.ts; not physical execution.
definitions.forceUnits: Raw engine force: kg*yd/s^2. Raw engine impulse: kg*yd/s. No SI conversion is applied; these are not newtons or newton-seconds.
definitions.load: Nonzero hypot(primary normal,tangent); individual helpers only when their forces were actually recorded. Tick-start labels with end bounds, not exact continuous force integrals.
definitions.phase: Controller phase-entry command ticks; cached Power baseline has no phase telemetry.
definitions.impacts: Positive native report contact impulse between two offensive slots, identified using native i/j. Samples can repeat a physical encounter.
definitions.firstRBContact: First native carrier_contact event, separate from terminal tackle.
definitions.context: All22 players react normally; terminal continuations are uncensored. No film, new simulation or future-path forcing.
definitions.lateRetargetQualification: Final K01 RG changes from DE_W to LB_W at3.75, after first RB contact3.70. Its later Will force is not end-kick protection. Existing availability/retarget gate risk is preserved for review, not bundled into this patch.
definitions.PowerRoleQualification: Power LG has installed pullRole kick and target LB_S in this one-back setup. It makes useful second-level contact but is not relabeled a conventional lead/wrap job.
